protocol: Astra prover -> separate fresh Astra referee (claim+report+data only). Built from referee verdict.json files only. A claim is accepted iff its referee per-claim verdict is CORRECT/CORRECT_WITH_FIXES (fixes adopted in PROOF_NOTES.md §4n). r13_compare overall GAP is confined to unverifiable sampling-history claims, which are not accepted. Strategy proposals and conjectures (UNVERIFIED) are not theorems.
headline_verified: A: GEN_{K-1}+Odeg_K+OH_K => MASS_{2K-1}; MASS_{2K-1}+E_K (or EH_K) => GEN_K (conditional induction); parity compression; B1+B2 => TD => ROOT => RAD
A: unrestricted E/EU fail at K=6; endpoint cap lambda=7 possible without criticality; START not derivable from pair loss (Robertson)

B: ICD assembly: REAL(ell<=a) + ICD(ell>a) => REAL for all ell (incl. all RAD); radius transfer; ICD for unit-regular radius-2, coronas, projective grafts, irregular pentagon planes; balanced core-cover LP false (PG(2,11) corona)

Compare N4.1: under full critical loss, pointwise endpoint inequality E <=> all-start + cap; N4.2 trivial-reserve diagnostic; N4.3 nonadjacent rigid pairs have distance>=3; N4.4 min-cut criticality test
proposals_not_verified: B1/B2 block inequalities at all orders
ICD_K for K>=6 / restricted exchange theorem for irregular (C4,C5)-free graphs

claims.statement: Accepted GEN_3/4/5 and radius reductions; no new GEN_6 or RAD theorem is claimed.
The direct GEN_K band does not cover RAD(K+1), and radius minimality does not supply arbitrary deletion criticality.
Equations (1) and (2): exact deletion, endpoint weighted charge, unit survival and reserve accounting.
Equation (3): a minimum counterexample has D(U)>=K|U|+epsilon.
GEN_(K-1)+Odeg_K+OH_K implies MASS_(2K-1); MASS+E_K or EH_K implies GEN_K.
OP implies OH; Odeg+START suffices for MASS; EU implies E; E implies EH; OH implies OH-res.
OH/EH are equivalent to integral assignments for nonnegative integer capacities.
Equation (5): a positive-surplus obstruction violates the all-source exact-reserve row.
Equation (6), including the -M triangle correction, and the cut reduction for EH.
Equation (7): k nontriangular loss-(K+1) neighbors force L(v)>=K+1+k for a proper star.
Odd equations (8),(9) and even equations (10),(11), including attachment and clique/forest structure.
Complete endpoint contact reduction, lambda(x)<=q-2 and initial order <=2q-2<=4K-2.
Equation (12), exact C4-safety test and equality triangle exclusion.
Equation (13), positive-trace necessity and sufficient dual certificate (15).
B1+B2 imply TD; TD implies corrected ROOT; the accepted structural reduction then gives RAD.
C5 exclusion yields gap 2; induced C5/C6/C7 exclusion yields gap 4 and q>=4lambda(x)-1.
Local extension rules and open leaves do not establish a uniform structural theorem or termination.
Complete specified one-contact domains at t=9,10,11,12 and all saved invariants.
All 636 local probe domains, trace filters, exact packing caps, rounds and closures.
Component and vertex reserve flows, and odd equal-split OP failure counts.
Complete connected 4-regular girth>=5 catalogue on 17..21 vertices and classifications.
All 32 four-center-edge triangle decorations and the stated path/charge classifications.
14,742 skeleton root checks, 67 extra graph records, 1,541 assignments, one Hall witness and 6,700 partition tests.
All 227 roots and every rigid pair of the 11 regular blocks satisfy B1/B2.
The t12 contacts-{1,2,3} graph refutes unrestricted E/EU.
The t11 and t12 six-contact graphs have global endpoints of unit degree 7.
Robertson disproves deriving START solely from singleton/pair losses.
The base graph has root-8 maximum 8, terminal set {10,11} and deletion loss 16>14.
The prescribed-edge extension refutes EP(9), with q=9 and D(E)=20>18.
Two Petersen graphs identified at one vertex refute unrestricted STAR_5.
The supplied order-15 graph has W=14>C_B=12 and D(B)=32>30.
Heawood tails refute bare flow even without C5; a one-tail control refutes the even one-per-A flow.
Hashes and byte sizes of supplied report/data artifacts match the manifest.
Uniform odd endpoint unit-degree bound in the admissible class.
Uniform odd Hall inequality or its component-reserve alternative.
Uniform equal-split local odd bound.
Uniform assertion that every vertex starts the odd maximum path.
Uniform even endpoint weighted/unit/Hall assertions and endpoint cap.
Block inequalities at all orders and rooted indices.
GEN_K for K>=6 and new RAD cases from this strategy.
Every connected strong C4-free G with S/n>6 has a proper connected dominating induced H with p(H)<=p(G)-2 and J(H)<=J(G)-1, J=p-ceil(S/n).
The same core assertion whenever S/n>2.
Above density six, some eligible core has ell(G)-ell(H)<=p(G)-p(H)-1.
For any density cutoff a, REAL below a together with ICD above a implies REAL at every density.
ICD is equivalent to S(H)>(ceil(S/n)-p(G)+p(H))*|H|, and to positivity of some M_j.
An actual path lower bound and a core path upper bound satisfying inequality (C) certify ICD without exact p(G).
ICD holds for strong C4-free radius-two graphs of constant unit degree d>=3.
Uniform pendant-path coronas with ell>2 admit a density-increasing eligible core.
If every base vertex starts a longest base path, the one-leaf corona has exactly one eligible core, its base.
A vertex-balanced nonnegative weighting of eligible cores need not exist even at ell=7.
The unbounded-radius projective graft family has the exact n,S,r,p formulas (2) and a density-increasing eligible core.
Deleting one external plane vertex, adding a root triangle and any number of root-edge pentagons gives an ICD graph for every prime q>=5.
Unit incidence girth is at least ten, but projected induced paths require the stated clean-unit condition.
Strong C4-free graphs have e=O(n^(3/2)); ordinary fixed-size dense flags tend to edgeless flags.
Petersen refutes RD without a density cutoff; Petersen and Heawood refute fixed one-unit density retention.
995 ell>2 graph records pass ICD; graph records include a repeated Petersen isomorphism class.
Five planes, one corona and three irregular pentagonal modifications have saved positive core certificates.
Stress-test rounded core descent, then attack irregular C5-free core exchanges, then overlapping pentagonal pieces.
The explicit ICD_K assertions for all integers K>=6.
A connected dominating induced H satisfies r(G)<=r(H)+1.
RD implies ICD, and RD is equivalent to D(U)<=ell(G)|U|+(d-1)|H|.
The PG(2,11) corona has n=532,S=3724,ell=7 and exact potential drop 7 to its unique eligible base.
The graft family has unbounded density, asymptotic limiting density sqrt(r/2), and satisfies REAL directly.
A triangle-free graph with no C4 or C5 and minimum degree delta>=2 has p>=2delta+1.
The saved Petersen Hamilton path becomes an induced incidence path of order 19, while graph p is 5.
Every K_1,m, m>=2, refutes ICD without a density cutoff.
A radius-two center neighborhood has J=1; at ell>2 its ICD success is equivalent to REAL at radius two.
Two Petersens sharing a vertex have shared unit degree six and rooted path maximum five.
All connected strong C4-free classes through 12 have the claimed counts; the selected core domain contains 4,413 graphs.
The complete n=13,14 domains and first-5,000 n=15,16 samples produce 58 retained graphs.
The Petersen, Heawood and two-Petersen control table gives exact p,r,mass and core optima.
The small catalogue has 27 ICD failures with eligible cores, all p=3 and ell<2, and nine other graphs with no eligible core.
The auxiliary table has all 244 rooted connected dominating Petersen states containing root 0.
The five saved graft evaluations equal the proved formulas.
The supplied verification JSON files report PASS and the listed numerical outputs.
The original r13_verify.py imported no producer code and used the algorithm described in section 3.6.
The manifest matches the supplied report, certificate files and accepted context.
A connected dominating chain with total J drop at least its length gives the same conditional assembly.
The summary accurately labels the route proposed, sufficiency/families proved, finite checks computed, and general ICD/REAL open.

sessions.overall_reason: GAP is restricted to explicit finite sampling-history assertions that cannot be independently verified from the allowed package. No false proved mathematical lemma or mismatch in any supplied graph/core certificate was found. General conjectures remain correctly open.
required_fixes: For section 4.5, supply the 602 omitted non-target graph records with path certificates and a complete text specification of the sampler (including random-call/order conventions), or label the 7929 total, safe-attempt counts and non-target path histogram as unverified historical outputs. Producer source code is not required.

Distinguish verification of the supplied 7327 mixed target records from reproduction of the claimed 20000-attempt seed run. The same provenance qualification applies to seeds used to choose the dense examples; their certificates themselves are verified.

Qualify artifact/provenance claims to the files actually supplied. Include independently reproducible mathematical sampling rules and usable artifact-relative links. Do not imply that absent producer/verifier source was inspected.

For partition-test histories, provide the exact partition selector if exact run reproduction is intended; otherwise report the independent replacement checks separately. The deletion and Hall-cut identities themselves are proved and pass all replacement checks.
